issues.description: The problem statement and UML require addGuestStudents to accept two parameters (int, String) but the solution implementation provides addGuestStudents with only a single int parameter. This parameter mismatch means the solution does not implement the API specified in the exercise and would confuse students expecting to provide a reason string (and could cause tests or usage that call addGuestStudents(int, String) to fail).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's addGuestStudents method signature to include the String reason parameter to match the problem specification (e.g. public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) { this.numberOfGuestStudents += numberOfNewGuestStudents; /* optionally log or store reason */ }). Ensure the template and any examples also reflect the two-parameter signature.
